entryChoreography.gate: §七, 11 of 11 self-scorable items PASS; items 12 and 13 are a judgement at 1x and are left to the product owner
entryChoreography.whatItRestsOn: the Target's entry is one spring on the grid gap ratio, read out of its bundle and then recovered from its live DOM at 3.00000 -> 0.04500 with a 0.001 px worst residual. The candidate runs the same law from the same constants and lands inside the Target's own run-to-run spread on every timing landmark at all four review viewports.
entryChoreography.tightness: the two crossings recovered from the gap curve agree to about a millisecond at every viewport: 50% at 146.7 vs 147.5, 147.5 vs 147.3, 147.3 vs 147.2 and 147.5 vs 147.4 ms; 90% at 358.6 vs 358.0, 358.5 vs 358.7, 358.2 vs 358.6 and 358.4 vs 359.1 ms.
entryChoreography.theOneWideItem: at 700x700 the visible-settle landmark passes inside a Target window that is 418 ms wide -- half its own median. That is a weaker statement than the p50/p90 agreement and is flagged as such in entry-gate.json -> windowQuality. The landmark is a threshold on visible pixel movement and the last cards to stop moving are the ones furthest off-centre; both pages are noisy on it.

60 Hz emulation for the pacing pass (§八), which this round did not run.

The Target's own labels carry a transform only once coverage has drawn them; ours are posed through CSS3DRenderer, whose style cache skips unchanged writes but which still walks every mounted object. The per-frame cost of that walk is now bounded by the Target's own mount count and was not the orientation cost this round removed.
commitOrderNote: §十二 suggests card lifecycle before CSS3D lifecycle. They are committed the other way round so that EVERY commit compiles on its own: the card-lifecycle commit reads the CSS3D layer's new mount census for the device readout, and would not typecheck without it. §十二 also says the CSS3D commit is NONE if forensics disproves pool recycling. Forensics DID disprove recycling -- and found the Target's actual policy, which is to mount exactly cols x rows. That policy is bounded, it is derived from source rather than chosen, and §八's 'mounted CSS3D nodes materially approach the Target' is unreachable without it. It is isolated in its own commit so it can be dropped if the owner reads §十二 more strictly.
